req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /tasks/?skip=<s>&limit=<l> skips the first 'skip' items and caps results at 'limit'. The pre-loaded dataset has exactly 20 rows (ids 1-20). Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — typical skip+limit returning correct slice; (2) negative NEG — invalid skip/limit values (negative, zero-limit, out-of-range) returning 422; (3) boundary BVA — skip=0/limit=1 (minimum boundary), skip=19/limit=1 (last item), skip=20/limit=1 (past end returns empty), limit=1000 (max allowed), limit=1001 (exceeds max). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact counts, exact item ids, exact status codes, and testing both sides of every boundary (limit=1 vs limit=0, skip=0 vs skip=-1, limit=1000 vs limit=1001).

tests.name: test_pagination_skip2_limit3_returns_correct_slice
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
Tasks are returned in insertion order (id ascending)
actions: Send GET /tasks/?skip=2&limit=3 to the in-process FastAPI app
expected: Response body is a JSON array of exactly 3 items
Items correspond to tasks with ids 3, 4, 5 (0-indexed rows 2,3,4)
trace: R-TASK-005: skip=2 skips first 2 rows; limit=3 caps at 3 results
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base, SessionLocal
from app import models

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
tasks_data = [
    {"id": i, "title": f"Task {i}", "description": None, "completed": False}
    for i in range(1, 21)
]
for t in tasks_data:
    db.add(models.Task(title=t["title"], description=t["description"], completed=t["completed"]))
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=2&limit=3")
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert len(body) == 3
assert body[0]["id"] == 3
assert body[1]["id"] == 4
assert body[2]["id"] == 5

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base, SessionLocal
from app import models

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
for i in range(1, 21):
    db.add(models.Task(title=f"Task {i}", description=None, completed=(i % 2 == 0)))
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=2")
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert len(body) == 2
for item in body:
    assert "id" in item
    assert "title" in item
    assert "completed" in item
    assert "created_at" in item
    assert isinstance(item["id"], int)
    assert isinstance(item["completed"], bool)
assert body[0]["completed"] == False
assert body[1]["completed"] == True
